fact: Werz hands over five unusual gems as a gesture of good faith for the assassin job.
source_quote: Werz handed over five unusual gems, suggesting they ask their gnomish companions why they were special
subject: Werz

fact: Jimjar had heard Werz's name in Blingdenstone and believes Werz is honest about being worth trading with.
source_quote: Jimjar had heard Werz's name in Blingdenstone and thinks Werz is probably honest about being worth trading with
subject: Werz

fact: Kazook Pickshine is a gnomish alchemist in Blingdenstone who would pay handsomely for the empty spell gems.
source_quote: a gnomish alchemist named Kazook Pickshine would pay handsomely for them
subject: Kazook Pickshine

fact: Jimjar identifies the gems as empty spell gems used in Blingdenstone's magical defenses.
source_quote: he identified them as empty spell gems — the very kind used in the magical defenses of Blingdenstone
subject: Jimjar

fact: Jimjar notes that the gems are considered 'kind of banal gems' to anyone other than Kazook Pickshine.
source_quote: but that to anyone else they are "kind of banal gems"
subject: Jimjar

fact: The party returns to Ghohlbrorn's Lair to collect ordered magical equipment.
source_quote: Back at Ghohlbrorn's Lair, the party collected the magical equipment they had previously ordered
subject: Ghohlbrorn

fact: Thorin acquires a new +1 longsword at a 10% discount.
source_quote: a +1 longsword for Thorin, paid for at a 10% discount out of pooled party funds
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin's order included splint armor, a +1 longsword, and darts.
source_quote: Thorin's order had been splint armor, a +1 longsword if possible, and darts
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin argues that breeding violent quaggoths is eugenics with sentient people, which is wrong.
source_quote: Thorin: "That's eugenics… But with sentient people, that's wrong."
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin asks Stool how Rumpadump will ensure the party does not get hurt.
source_quote: Thorin: "How will he make sure we don't get hurt?"
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin plans to tell the assassins that radical transparency would solve everything.
source_quote: Thorin plans to tell the assassins radical transparency would solve everything
subject: Thorin

fact: Zalthir receives two enchanted tattoos.
source_quote: two enchanted tattoos for Zalthir
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir recalls seeing an unhappy myconid sprout near dancing myconids in the caverns below.
source_quote: Zalthir recalled an unhappy myconid sprout he had seen near a group of strangely dancing myconids in the caverns below
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir notes that Rumpadump looked depressed, while the other myconids were shaking or dancing and looked concerning.
source_quote: Zalthir notes Rumpadump looked depressed, "but the other ones were shaking or dancing and looked concerning."
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir reminds the group that there were many myconids and a scary ape-like creature.
source_quote: Zalthir reminds the group there were a lot of myconids "and like the scary ape thing."
subject: Zalthir

fact: Stool recognizes the unhappy sprout as his friend Rumpadump.
source_quote: Stool recognised it as his friend Rumpadump
subject: Stool

fact: Stool pleads with the party to drop everything and save Rumpadump.
source_quote: pleaded with the party to drop everything and save him
subject: Stool

fact: Stool states that myconids do not attack people unnecessarily, but will attack back if attacked.
source_quote: Myconids don't attack people unnecessarily… But if you attack us, we attack back
subject: Stool

fact: Stool contrasts the civilized Prince Derendil with most quaggoths, which he calls brutish and savage.
source_quote: Stool contrasts the "very civilized" Prince Derendil with most quaggoths, which he calls brutish and savage
subject: Stool

fact: Stool argues that quaggoths are bred to be violent, comparing them to mushroom strains bred for flavor.
source_quote: Stool: "It's in their nature to be violent. They are bred to be violent," comparing them to mushroom strains the myconids breed for flavor
subject: Stool

fact: Stool says that if Rumpadump is worried, something is very worrisome.
source_quote: Stool: "If Rumpadump is worried, something is very worrisome."
subject: Stool

fact: Stool fears other members of his circle may be at Rumpadump's location.
source_quote: He fears other members of his circle may be there too
subject: Stool

fact: Stool asks if the party can drop everything to find Rumpadump right now.
source_quote: asks, "Can we drop everything and go find out right now?"
subject: Stool

fact: Stool promises that Rumpadump will ensure the party does not get hurt.
source_quote: Stool: "I promise you, Rumpadump will make sure we don't get hurt."
subject: Stool

fact: Stool states that everyone has a purpose in the circle.
source_quote: Stool: "Everyone has a purpose in the circle."
subject: Stool

fact: Stool states that he trusts Rumpadump.
source_quote: Stool: "I trust Rumpadump."
subject: Stool

fact: Daz compares breeding quaggoths for violence to the breeding of orange carrots.
source_quote: Daz: "It is how we ended up with orange carrots."
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum wants to deal with the assassins before rescuing Rumpadump.
source_quote: Gyrgum wanted to deal with the assassins first
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum suggests discovering the assassins before going to rescue Rumpadump.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "We're a lot of layers deep already… What if we do that after we discover the assassins?"
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum suggests that a radical transparent approach would be telling the assassins not to kill Werz or be killed.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "Radically transparent would probably be: you don't kill him, or we'll kill you."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum thinks the empty spell gems might be valuable to him depending on their usage.
source_quote: Gyrgum, as a cleric, thinks they might be valuable to him depending on how they can be used
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Rumpadump is Stool's friend who was seen looking depressed among dancing myconids.
source_quote: Stool recognised it as his friend Rumpadump
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Prince Derendil is referenced by Stool as a 'very civilized' individual in contrast to most quaggoths.
source_quote: Stool contrasts the "very civilized" Prince Derendil with most quaggoths
subject: Prince Derendil
